name: Shelfback Elm
text: An old elm stacked with bracket fungi. Over many days it grows into a giant three tiles wide, and the ground around it turns dark and rich.

name: Giant Toadstool
text: A mushroom grown as big as a tree. Its cap shades the ground like a canopy.

name: Fallen Giant
text: A toppled trunk, mossy and hollow. Small things live inside it.

name: Bog Seep
text: A dark, wet hollow. It counts as water, so Spore soil spreads out from it.

name: Mossy Trough
text: An old stone trough furred with moss. It counts as water.

name: Puffball Mound
text: A cluster of great white puffballs.

name: Inkcap Tower
text: Tall stacked caps that drip ink after rain.

name: Toadstool Circle
text: A few toadstools that slowly spread into a full fairy circle, three tiles across.

name: Rotting Log Seat
text: A log to sit on, slowly sprouting fungi.

name: Root Cellar Mound
text: An earth mound with a little round door.

name: Lantern Willow
text: Drooping fronds that glow at dusk. Given many days, it grows into a giant three tiles wide.

name: Foxfire Pine
text: A pine whose bark is veined with green light.

name: Moon Pool
text: A basin that shines on clear nights. It counts as water.

name: Firefly Puddle
text: Shallow water where fireflies gather after rain. It counts as water.

name: Glowcap Stand
text: A clump of tall, luminous caps.

name: Lantern Lily Clump
text: Bell flowers that hold a light inside.

name: Glowworm Fern
text: Fronds strung with tiny lights.

name: Jar Shrine
text: A shelf of glass jars that slowly fill with glow.

name: Glowstone Arch
text: An archway of glowing stones.

name: Petalfall Tree
text: A blossom tree that drops petals all around it. Given many days, it grows into a giant three tiles wide.

name: Honey Linden
text: A sweet-flowered tree, loved by bees.

name: Lily Basin
text: A round basin of water lilies. It counts as water.

name: Rose Bramble
text: A tangle of wild roses.

name: Hollyhock Spire
text: Tall spikes of open flowers.

name: Peony Bush
text: Big, round, heavy blooms.

name: Flower Arch
text: A trellis arch, wound with flowers.

name: Bee Skep
text: A woven hive humming with bees.

name: Old Oak
text: The heart of a grove. Over many days it grows into a giant three tiles wide, with leaf mould thick beneath it.

name: Great Beech
text: A smooth grey trunk under a dense canopy.

name: Birch Stand
text: A cluster of thin birches.

name: Reed Spring
text: A little spring ringed with reeds. It counts as water.

name: Rain Barrel
text: A barrel that fills on wet days. It counts as water.

name: Giant Fern
text: Head-high fronds.

name: Hedge
text: A clipped green hedge. Set them side by side to make a wall.

name: Hazel Thicket
text: Hazel bushes heavy with nuts.

name: Hedge Arch
text: A doorway grown through a hedge.

name: Tree Platform
text: A little lookout on stilts, with a rope ladder.

name: Crystal Birch
text: A birch with leaves of glass. Given many days, it grows into a giant three tiles wide.

name: Prism Aspen
text: Leaves that split the sunlight into rainbows.

name: Mirror Pond
text: Perfectly still water that reflects the sky. It counts as water.

name: Crystal Fountain
text: Water trickling over quartz. It counts as water.

name: Glassreed Clump
text: Reeds of glass that ring faintly in the wind.

name: Prism Rose Bush
text: Roses with petals like coloured glass.

name: Geode Seat
text: A split geode, just right to sit on.

name: Prism Obelisk
text: A tall crystal that throws light patterns at noon.

name: Weeping Yew
text: Ancient and drooping, with mist pooling beneath. Given many days, it grows into a giant three tiles wide.

name: Misty Pine
text: Tall and dark, its top lost in the mist.

name: Ghost Birch
text: Pale bark that seems to glow in fog.

name: Still Tarn
text: Dark, deep, still water; mist rises from it at dawn. It counts as water.

name: Moss-stone Font
text: A stone font, cold and mossy. It counts as water.

name: Mistbell Thicket
text: A thicket of pale, nodding bells.

name: Ghost Orchid Clump
text: Leafless orchids that float in the mist.

name: Standing Stone
text: A tall, weathered stone. Set a few in a ring.

name: Waystone
text: A carved marker stone; paths seem to lead to it.

name: Lantern Stone
text: A stone lamp, lit at dusk.

name: Boardwalk
text: Planks to walk on.

name: Moss Path
text: Soft moss, trodden into a path.

name: Stone Wall
text: A low dry-stone wall. Set them side by side.

name: Swing
text: A rope swing on a little frame.

name: Footbridge
text: A little wooden bridge. It goes on the water.

name: Stepping-stone Ford
text: Flat stones across a stream. It goes on the water.
